meta.parties: Wijesundera and Others v. Constantine Dasa and Another

rules.statement: The burden of proving prescriptive possession is entirely on the defendants when the paper title is admitted to be in the plaintiffs.
rules.supporting_quote: "For this submission counsel relied on the following passage in the judgment which reads thus (as translated): 'The main question for decision is whether James Wijesundera after his purchase of the land got vacant possession from the defendants or whether one or more of the defendants continued to reside on the land after the sale in the same manner as they did before the sale.'"
